newsitem.title: USA: Mallon Resources' new New Mexico output.
newsitem.headline: Mallon Resources' new New Mexico output.

text.p: Mallon Resources Corp said the Bonanza Federal No. 1 Well has been completed and placed on production in Eddy County, N.M., and is producing 130 barrels of oil per day from the Delaware Formation at 7,300 feet.
The well is the first Antelope Ridge Prospect well in which Mallon has participated. It owns a 25 percent working interest in the well, operated by Strata Production Co.

The company also said it successfully re-entered the O'Neill Federal No. 1 Well in Eddy County. The well was originally completed as a Bones Springs Formation sour gas well at approximately 5,300 feet in 1970.

In April, Mallon said, it reentered the well and perforated eight feet of the Morrow Formation at about 11,200 feet. The well is on production and is flowing 1.4 million cubic feet of natural gas per day. Mallon is operator and owns an 85.9 percent working interest until payout, after which its working interest will decrease to 57.3 percent.
"By re-entering an existing bore hole, we were able to put this gas on production for about half the cost of drilling a new well," the company pointed out.
